Activate delimitR environment (created in Anaconda). don't forget to deactivate when you are done.

```         
(base) maysh-mac:Zosterops Methods and Results maysh$ conda activate delimitR
(delimitR) maysh-mac:Zosterops Methods and Results maysh$ cd 
```
